newsitem.title: USA: Elk Hills sale must show fair return -- US DOE.
newsitem.headline: Elk Hills sale must show fair return -- US DOE.

text.p: U.S. Energy Secretary Federico Pena Friday stressed that the department will not sell the Elk Hills Naval Petroleum Reserve unless independent experts show it would be a good deal for taxpayers.
Sen. Dale Bumpers, D-Ark., earlier this week said he would try a last-ditch effort to stop the sale of the oil field in California.
Bumper said he thought the sale would not bring a fair return and was a wrong policy given the country's concerns about its rising dependence on imported oil.
But he said he doubted his effort would succeed.

Pena, speaking to reporters after addressing the Independent Petroleum Association of America, said the department would not go through with the sale if it appeared there would not be a decent return, and said the department, as well as Bumpers, would have to be convinced it was a fair deal.
